name: Amaranth

schedule.notes: Wait for warm soil. Surface-sow; tiny seeds need light.
Leaves: when 4 to 8 in. Grain: cut whole heads when seeds rub free with thumb.

harvest.cues: Leaves: glossy, 4 to 8 in, before flower stalks. Grain: heads drying and brown; rub seeds free.
harvest.storageNotes: Leaves: fridge 3 to 5 days. Grain: dry, winnow, store in airtight jars for years.

varieties.name: Red Leaf
varieties.notes: Deep red leaves. Cook like spinach, holds color. Strong earthy flavor.

varieties.name: Golden Grain
varieties.notes: Bred for grain. Tall (5 to 6 ft) with massive seed heads, white-cream kernels.

varieties.name: Love-Lies-Bleeding
varieties.notes: Dramatic dangling crimson tassels. Edible grain, but mostly grown for the spectacle.

notes: Heat-lover, drought-tolerant once established. Self-seeds aggressively — let one head shatter and you'll have volunteers everywhere. Leaves are higher in protein and minerals than most greens.
